english.title: Attempt to possess a controlled drug of Class B - Cannabis / Cannabis Resin
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) attempted to have in your possession

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE QUANTITY..)]_
(B)_[a quantity]_

of

(C)_[cannabis,]_
(D)_[cannabis resin,]_
(E)_[cannabis and cannabis resin,]_

a controlled drug of class B, in contravention of section 5(1) of the Misuse of Drugs Act 1971
english.legislation: Contrary to section 1(1) of the Criminal Attempts Act 1981.

investigatoraction.description: Submit a form Crimsec 38 where drugs are seized

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) Simple possession of cannabis (and its derivatives) is a PND offence (see section 1 Criminal Justice and Police Act 2001). This came into force on the 28/1/09, per SI 110/2009.
(ii) See the MOJ CIrcular in relation to PND and cannabis.

other.penalty:
Summary: Three months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding two thousand five hundred pounds.
Indictment: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

None
